drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 65-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.85, creatinine 0.91-0.93, hemoglobin 13.3-13.4, platelets 214-221, sodium 129-132, wbc 6.7-6.9; vitals dbp 66-72, heart_rate 76-81, map 85-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 120-126, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Fluid restriction 1.2 L/day; Sodium chloride 1 g PO TID
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.92-0.95, hemoglobin 13.2-13.5, platelets 215-221, sodium 132-135, wbc 6.9-7.3; vitals dbp 68-71, heart_rate 76-81, map 86-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 119-126, spo2 97-98, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 65-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
